meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目中的知识图谱文件，根据你的提问搜索相关代码节点、函数、类等，并解释它们之间的关系和所属架构层。
howto.when: 当你询问代码库相关问题，如“这个函数是做什么的”或“模块A依赖哪些文件”时触发。

say.text: 请解释一下这个项目中 main.py 的作用。
函数 calculate_total 依赖哪些其他函数？
say.note: Claude 会查找该函数的依赖关系。

say.text: 这个项目使用了哪些框架？
say.note: Claude 会从项目元数据中提取框架信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the knowledge graph file in the project, searches for relevant code nodes (files, functions, classes, etc.) based on your query, and explains their relationships and architectural layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about the codebase, such as 'What does this function do?' or 'What files does module A depend on?'

say_en.text: Explain the role of main.py in this project.
say_en.note: Claude searches for the main.py node in the knowledge graph and explains it.

say_en.text: What other functions does calculate_total depend on?
say_en.note: Claude finds the dependency edges for that function.

say_en.text: Which frameworks does this project use?
say_en.note: Claude extracts framework info from project metadata.
